notes.title: Winter Under Control - Watch ⌚ and Toolbox 🧰 UPDATE!
notes.notes:
😎 Hey Snow Plowing Fans! ⛄️

🏔️⛷️ I have a new update for you due to the start of the sale - you're sure to like it. Along with it, we're introducing two new interesting features, plus a few other cool solutions :D Let's get started! 🏂❄️

🔹 I added unique watches! ⌚

There are two available for purchase in the store:
Nanoband - shows the time and temperature
Smartpear - shows the time and temperature several hours ahead!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/984c1f5a71609971cc537bc4241b930a703ba4c6.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/31cc7608a5670f96e04f582e42d5746df08cf7d3.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/54ec7307bb17bb74db6f055bfefb3711319e6088.png
This will help you plan your work well-snow removal is taking on a new face 😊

🔹 I've also added a toolbox  🧰  - now you can repair tools (shovels, snow blowers, clothes, plows) using your repair kit! No need to go back to the garage to sell broken tools and buy new ones. This will make your work easier and more comfortable
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/895f43e65297d72b7fffd758ead0a18e2703e4ac.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/784d7f563598297b88f55e0408fcf6d05acf189c.png

And other interesting changes:

🔹 new version of load - save
🔹 removal of the map switch
🔹 closing windows with the same key as opening them
🔹 changes to game balance - calories
🔹 changes to game balance - player temperature
🔹 repair of quad activation from old saves
🔹 reduced amount of coffee
🔹 equalization of prices for work performed
🔹 cosmetic changes to the main menu
🔹 new mini-map interface
🔹 fixing problems with recent tasks

Have fun and let us know what you think of the update!
⬇️⬇️⬇️

notes.title: Christmas Update!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=xlZ84BegK4g;full][/previewyoutube]
☃️🏂Hey snow fans!🤶❄️🌨️ 

Santa have surprise for You❗️🎅  
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/159696cea4e420fe98341e9b4a1468e32a907577.png
What does this mean?🎁

Our Santa is not very clever - he loses presents that fall out of his sleigh. Your task is to find them. If you manage to find them all, you will be rewarded!


How does the event work? I will describe it to you in a few steps:
1. You can collect gifts from 19 to 31 December. They will appear one per day from 19 to 24 December, so there will be 6 in total.
2. Santa will appear on 25 December. You will be able to talk to him until 31 December to collect your prize.
3. Gifts appear on the map - they are marked with a gift. You may occasionally have to dig them out by using a shovel!
4. Is it possible to collect presents on, say, 31 December and meet Santa then?
Of course, yes. Then there will simply be 6 gifts marked, which you can collect in one go. Then you will also be able to talk to Santa right away.
5. What presents can you get?
For now we are not revealing, but in our opinion the gift will be cool!
6. From 1 January the event will no longer be available. 
7. Does time count? For example, if I talk to Santa on the 25th of December, instead of the 31st?
No. We know that you may have less time through the festive period, so this is not counted in any way. All that matters is that you complete the event by 31 December.


Let us know how you like the updateːsteamthumbsupː
We fixed small bugs with cars and NPC too.

Merry Christmas!🎅
SPS Team & Santa

notes.title: Autosave and major optimization progress update!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=3mE0YRT3FXs;full][/previewyoutube]
☃️Hey snow fans!❄️🌨️ 

We would like to present you an optimisation update with the introduction of auto-save! In addition, we have a few more features, including direct contact with us through the gameːthebuilderː ːladyengineerː Without further delays, let's start❗️

🖥️Optimalisation💻 
 1. Changing from DirectX12 to DirectX11👨‍💻 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/298eaa16319b3dafaebda45923a7cb17c068c08c.jpg
Changing to DirectX11 allows for a drastic reduction of stuttering in Snow Plowing. There should no longer be random FPS drops when moving/driving a car (after changing DirectX12 to DirextX11, remember to click save and do a game relog!)

2. Snow track accuracy⛄️🌨️
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/9170fe5eb45eb7d71258f2561f2bfa4b03c0c51d.jpg
You can change this value from 1 to 20. 1 - the most frequent, default refresh rate, 20 - the rarest. The closer you get to 20, the more FPS you will have. My advice is to change from 1 to 4 to start with and see the difference in FPS (we tested it on a couple of computers and the difference is big, sometimes as much as 50% more FPS with options closer to 20), then calibrate the frequency to your preference. (Note - at option 20, due to the infrequent refresh rate, the snow may look a little strange, while the gameplay will be smoothest)

💾Autosave🎮
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/7b5340160e34f1b42fb0225e847b3ce0aee82771.jpg
The game will save itself every time you leave the property or leave the road which is a snow plowing mission. The option will be indicated by the autosave sign at the top of the screen.

You can still save from game menu (I recommend doing so at least at the end of a session in Snow Plowing, due to the fact that you may, for example, buy an tool, want to exit the game but do not exit the garage and 'auto-save' does not appear - in which case the latter action will not be saved) or on white board in HUB

📲Contact us📠
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/dcaaf936b44aada734745d1cfc499ef7164959bf.jpg
From now on, if you encounter a bug, you can immediately report it to us via the game by sending an additional save! (We also recommend that you put your e-mail address in the ‘write back’ field, which will allow us to fix your save if a bug is preventing you from continuing the game in some way🕵).
You can of course also report your ideas via this option🛠️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/87b0110fd0346745bfcf889974ff130dc3f59eff.jpg

👨‍🔧Fixing minor errors👩‍🔧
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42941814/802c1f95a04220ba7efbcd207081bf2efeebc1bc.jpg
We have improved the save system. You will have to wait a while longer before entering the game for the first time, but this will reduce your save. Some players used to have 250 megabytes in their save folder, now it will be around 50 megabytes. Your saves should load faster.

❗️Remember - Snow Plowing is still in Early Access. Gameplay errors can happen! Therefore, we look forward to your feedback. Most bugs are being fixed thanks to your reports❗️
